rfam.comment: A third preQ1-binding (preQ1-III riboswitch that differs structurally from preQ1 (RF00522) and preQ1-II (RF01054) was first reported for McCown et al. 2014 [1]. The structure of preQ1-III has been reported for Mathews et al. 2015 [2], preQ1-III riboswitch aptamer presents four pairing regions P1-P4, organised as a HL out-type pseudoknot in its structure. preQ1-II presents a bipartite architecture, wich permit a dynamic conformational switch involved in the expression platform accessibility. PreQ1-III riboswitch structure was reported in PDB: 4RZD_A [2] and 6XKN_A and 6XKO_A
